item.title: Remembering Brian
item.description: Thank you to everyone who came together last week to support each other and celebrate Brian's life. We'll continue to find ways to remember him.

item.title: Free Public Transport Extended to 31 May
item.description: Free public transport in Victoria has been extended to 31 May. From 1 June to 1 January 2027, all fares will be half-price.

item.title: Vic Govt Rego Rebate – 20% Off Registration
item.description: From 1 June to 31 July 2026, Victorians can apply for a 20% rego rebate via Service Victoria, saving an average of $186 per vehicle.

item.title: MotorEx Auto Show – Sat 2 May
item.description: One of Australia's largest auto shows is at Melbourne Showgrounds on 2 May. A great weekend option for car enthusiasts.

item.title: Business Transformation Committee – Tue 28 Apr
item.description: The Committee meets Tuesday to review Project Elevate progress and the budget and scope for PI8.

item.title: National Workers' Memorial Day – Tue 28 Apr
item.description: Memorial service at Argyle Square, Carlton, 10:30–11:30am. Honouring workers who have died or been injured on the job. Executive and Board attending.

item.title: Board Cyber Security Workshop – Tue 28 Apr
item.description: The Board is undertaking a Cyber Security workshop on Tuesday in the Boardroom.

item.title: April Town Hall – Wed 29 Apr
item.description: April Town Hall is on Wednesday. Leaders, please add any items to the agenda and presentation you'd like to share.

item.title: Executive Fortnightly Meeting – Wed 29 Apr
item.description: The Executive meets for its fortnightly meeting on Wednesday.

item.title: Flu Vaccinations & Skin Checks – Sign Up Now
item.description: Flu vaccinations and skin checks are available. Check the Wellness wrap-up on The Hub for details and to sign up.

item.title: Live Well, Lunch Well – Share Your Recipes
item.description: Share your go-to healthy lunch or snack recipes with the team via the All Staff Teams channel.

item.title: Acknowledgement of Country – Town Hall EOI
item.description: Interested in presenting the Acknowledgement of Country at a Town Hall? Sign up via the EOI post in the All Staff Teams channel.

item.title: Farewell Saba Aziz – 1 May
item.description: Saba Aziz, Business Analyst in EPMO, finishes up on 1 May. We thank her for her contributions and wish her well.

item.title: OHS Reminder – Keep Walkways Clear
item.description: Chairs left in walkways are a trip hazard. Please push your chair under your desk when stepping away and keep areas around your workspace clear.

item.title: Kitchen Tidiness – Clean Up After Yourself
item.description: Kitchens must be left clean after use. Please clean up every time. Forgotten or expired food will be binned each Friday.

item.title: Habitat for Humanity – Volunteer Now
item.description: Our 2026 Habitat for Humanity volunteer program is open. Sign up to lend a helping hand to those in need. Details on The Hub.

item.title: Dirty Chairs? Bring Them to Level 6
item.description: Dirty chairs can be taken to Level 6 concierge for steam cleaning. Mark them with a post-it noting where they belong (e.g. L4.11).

item.title: Wellness Tip – Stand Up Every 30 Minutes
item.description: Reduce the effects of prolonged sitting by standing up and moving around for a minute or two every half hour.

item.title: Looking for a New Role? Check Team Tailor
item.description: Browse available internal and external roles on our recruitment platform, Team Tailor.

item.title: LOVE Awards – Nominate a Colleague
item.description: Seen a colleague living our values? Nominate them for a LOVE Award via The Hub.
